# Membership Secretary

The Club Membership Secretary is the key link between the Club and the Swim 
England membership team. 
They ensure all club members are members of Swim England.

This role is the main point of contact for all club membership enquiries.
They maintain up-to-date information and contact details for all club members, 
updating and making changes to the membership system.
They also Manage the club’s annual subscription and membership renewal process, 
ensuring membership fees are paid on time.


[Swim England role profile](https://www.swimming.org/library/documents/4081/download)
